correctness.rationale: Reconstructed independently distributed record indicators with Bernoulli(1/j), decrement R_m, H_m mean and H_m-H_m^(2) variance. Harmonic potential A(m) telescopes to D_n-A_n=-sum martingale differences -drift-debt, with expected accumulated debt <=C log n. Stopping at epsilon n gives occupation time (1-epsilon)n/log n and scaled predictable variance 1; middle visits and sub-n^(1/3) visits are negligible, centered fourth moments give Lindeberg O(log^4 n/n). The resulting Gaussian CLT is for fresh resampling only. Independent exact Stirling recurrence computed E D_4=2.4375, D_8=3.938150680..., D_13=5.537486634..., and all A_n-ED_n positive; not an asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: The full fifteen-page Zariski–Kratter source was examined at its matching Section 2.1: Theorem 3 only gives a mean recurrence for the resampled chain. Section 2.3 Theorem 10 proves Tracy-Widom for nonresampling. The new martingale limit and harmonic-potential exact center are not a corollary of either theorem without new variance and occupation estimates. Resultary returned only distinct record-biased permutation fluctuation results.
